ann.t: Press Release — SS Retail Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 13, 2026, titled "Media Release" having unaudited standalone and consolidated financial details as on September 30, 2026.

Outcome of Board Meeting — SS Retail Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the unaudited Standalone and Consolidated financial results and Limited Review Report for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.

Copy of Newspaper Publication — SS Retail Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication for highlights of the unaudited Standalone and Consolidated financials results of the Company for the quarter ended on June 30, 2026.
Outcome of Board Meeting — SS Retail Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended Jun 30, 2026.
